cards.title: Acorn Avenue Errand Desk Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: anchor an acorn errand beginning, carry one desk change, bridge a helper choice, show a small result, and return to the first folder clue
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder story-arc card for shaping one private family-friendly fictional Acorn Avenue errand-desk beginning, middle change, choice, result, and ending return: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place an accordion folder, blank paper, pencil, and one pretend acorn errand slip near the writer before starting: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: sort the acorn errand into a beginning pocket, middle change pocket, choice bridge pocket, result pocket, and ending return pocket: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write who finds the acorn errand slip and what first desk clue starts the arc: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: add one small change, such as a missing clip, new stamp mark, or shifted folder flap: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: choose how the helper handles the new folder clue with a paper-only action: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write the gentle story result of that choice at the errand desk: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first acorn slip or folder flap so the arc feels connected: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: label one accordion folder pocket with the beginning clue, middle change, or ending return: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the beginning clue and ending return blanks for the acorn errand: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later paper line: start another Acorn Avenue errand arc with one folder clue and one return note: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Map Mixup Story Arc Card

cards.kidDirection: Writer: make the map mixup begin with one button marker, change in the middle, and return to the first marker at the end: ____________________.

cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: add one new paper symbol that makes the map point differently: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: choose whether the helper follows the old marker, the new symbol, or a folded map corner: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write the story result that happens because the helper chose one map clue: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first button marker in a calmer, clearer way: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: tuck a map-mixup note into the pocket named beginning, middle, choice, result, or return: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw or write only the first button marker and the ending return marker: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later paper line: make another button-map arc with one mixed-up symbol and one return marker: ____________________.

cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill the beginning sign and ending echo, then pause the folder work: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later paper line: start another teacup-window arc with one paper weather sign that changes once: ____________________.
